records.entryNote: Headword + principal parts at 98248 ("capio, cepi, captum"); etymology bracket at 98260-98264 (Lat. capulum, Engl. haft, Goth. hinthan, seize).

note: L&S capio 释义 "to take in hand, take hold of, lay hold of, take, seize, grasp"，并给出 capulum / haft / hand / Goth. hinthan 的同源链，与 capere「抓」一致。
